focus: 由海床調查到樁群變形與耐久追蹤棧橋碼頭荷載~Trace pile-supported pier loads from seabed investigation to group deformation and durability

units.anchor: 鋼管截面與軸應力~Steel-pipe section and axial stress
units.title: 鋼管截面與軸應力~Steel-pipe section and axial stress
units.mechanism: 海上鋼管樁的空心截面不能用外包圓面積計材料應力，內外徑與腐蝕減薄都會改變承載面。平均軸應力只是彈性需求，局部屈曲、焊接細節和彎矩需另行處理；打設與服務狀態的作用也不同，不能以一個低平均值證明所有階段可靠。 假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。 ~A hollow steel pile requires annular material area rather than its outer circular footprint. Diameters and corrosion loss change that area. Mean axial stress is an elastic demand only; local buckling, weld details and bending remain separate. Installation and service actions also differ, so one low average stress cannot demonstrate reliability throughout every stage of the pile's use. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling.
units.verify: 核對實際壁厚與內外徑，量測多方向以辨識橢圓度和局部減薄，保留焊縫位置。將軸力、彎矩與施工動載分開列示，確認材料截面和土端阻用的承壓面積沒有混用。~Check actual thickness and diameters in several directions for ovality and local loss, retaining weld locations. List axial, bending and installation actions separately and confirm that steel material area is not confused with the area used for geotechnical toe resistance.
units.failure: 用外包面積除軸力會大幅低估空心鋼管應力，平均壁厚又可能掩蓋局部凹蝕。材料仍未屈服時，細薄區已可能因局部穩定問題控制反應。~Dividing by outer footprint grossly understates hollow-pile stress, while average thickness hides local pitting. A thin damaged region can govern local stability even when the average material stress remains below a nominal yield level.
units.misconception: 空心鋼管樁的材料受壓面積就是整個外徑圓面積。~The steel material area of a hollow pile equals its entire outer circular footprint.
units.practice: 核對實際壁厚與內外徑，量測多方向以辨識橢圓度和局部減薄，保留焊縫位置。將軸力、彎矩與施工動載分開列示，確認材料截面和土端阻用的承壓面積沒有混用。~Check actual thickness and diameters in several directions for ovality and local loss, retaining weld locations. List axial, bending and installation actions separately and confirm that steel material area is not confused with the area used for geotechnical toe resistance.

units.anchor: 樁端面積與土阻~Toe area and soil resistance
units.title: 樁端面積與土阻~Toe area and soil resistance
units.mechanism: 樁端土阻與材料截面不同，封閉端和開口管樁是否形成土塞會影響有效承壓面積。端阻單位值必須來自場址證據和相應變位，不是可任意套用的材料強度；計算名義端阻仍須考慮打設擾動、持力層厚度與下伏弱層。 假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。 ~Geotechnical toe area differs from steel area, and open-ended plugging determines whether an outer footprint is mobilized. Unit resistance requires site evidence at compatible displacement rather than a freely selected material strength. Even nominal toe resistance needs review of installation disturbance, bearing-layer thickness and weaker layers below, none of which is resolved by area multiplication alone. Assume a closed circular toe1m in diameter with uniform qb=5MPa. Qb=3927.0kN; this footprint is not assumed for an unverified open-pile plug.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a closed circular toe1m in diameter with uniform qb=5MPa. Qb=3927.0kN; this footprint is not assumed for an unverified open-pile plug.
units.verify: 在地質剖面標出樁端與持力層厚度，說明端部封閉或土塞證據，核對單位端阻對應的位移。比較試樁與施工紀錄，將下伏弱層與端部沉渣列入評估，不以名義直徑取代條件。~Mark toe depth and bearing-layer thickness, documenting closure or plugging and the displacement associated with unit resistance. Compare test piles and installation records, accounting for weaker underlying layers or toe debris rather than treating nominal diameter as complete evidence.
units.failure: 未形成土塞卻採完整圓面積會高估端阻，薄硬層下有軟層也可能發生穿透。施工紀錄只達到預定深度，不能單獨證明樁端已取得假設的力學行為。~Using full footprint without a developed plug overstates resistance, and a thin hard layer over soft ground may punch through. Reaching a specified depth during installation alone does not establish the assumed toe behavior or load-transfer mechanism.
units.misconception: 開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。~Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging.
units.practice: 在地質剖面標出樁端與持力層厚度，說明端部封閉或土塞證據，核對單位端阻對應的位移。比較試樁與施工紀錄，將下伏弱層與端部沉渣列入評估，不以名義直徑取代條件。~Mark toe depth and bearing-layer thickness, documenting closure or plugging and the displacement associated with unit resistance. Compare test piles and installation records, accounting for weaker underlying layers or toe debris rather than treating nominal diameter as complete evidence.

units.anchor: 樁側阻力積分~Integrating shaft resistance
units.title: 樁側阻力積分~Integrating shaft resistance
units.mechanism: 樁側剪力沿土層分布，平均值乘周長和長度只適合所定義區段。土體位移相對樁體的方向決定正側阻或負摩擦，不能把所有剪力都列為抵抗；側阻與端阻動員位移也不同，直接加總極值未必符合相同變形狀態。 假設D=1m、有效段長20m、均勻正側阻τ=50kPa，Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN；不含負摩擦或端阻。 ~Shaft shear varies by soil layer, and mean resistance times perimeter and length applies only to a defined segment. Relative soil-pile movement determines positive resistance or downdrag, so not all shear is beneficial. Shaft and toe resistance mobilize at different displacements, meaning their individual maxima may not coexist in a compatible overall load-transfer state for the pile. Assume diameter1m,effective length20m and uniform positive shaft shear50kPa. Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN, excluding downdrag and toe resistance.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設D=1m、有效段長20m、均勻正側阻τ=50kPa，Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN；不含負摩擦或端阻。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume diameter1m,effective length20m and uniform positive shaft shear50kPa. Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN, excluding downdrag and toe resistance.
units.verify: 按地層分段列出周長、長度與剪力方向，核對地下水及回填沉陷對相對位移的影響。利用應變或載重試驗重建傳力，避免把未動員的側阻和不同位移下端阻直接疊加。~Divide the shaft by layer, listing perimeter, length and shear direction, and examine groundwater or fill settlement effects on relative movement. Reconstruct transfer from strain or load testing, avoiding sums of unmobilized shaft resistance and toe resistance at incompatible displacements.
units.failure: 新填土沉降可能把原本預期的正摩擦變為下拉，樁側土受擾也使平均參數失準。若仍把整段剪力列成有利作用，樁內最大軸力可能被低估。~Settling new fill can turn expected positive friction into downdrag, while installation disturbance invalidates a mean parameter. Continuing to count all shaft shear as favorable can understate the maximum axial force within the pile itself.
units.misconception: 樁側所有摩擦力都必定向上提供抵抗而不會增加軸力。~Every shaft-friction force necessarily acts upward and can never increase pile compression.
units.practice: 按地層分段列出周長、長度與剪力方向，核對地下水及回填沉陷對相對位移的影響。利用應變或載重試驗重建傳力，避免把未動員的側阻和不同位移下端阻直接疊加。~Divide the shaft by layer, listing perimeter, length and shear direction, and examine groundwater or fill settlement effects on relative movement. Reconstruct transfer from strain or load testing, avoiding sums of unmobilized shaft resistance and toe resistance at incompatible displacements.

units.anchor: 樁群偏心分配~Eccentric pile-group distribution
units.title: 樁群偏心分配~Eccentric pile-group distribution
units.mechanism: 剛性承台在等軸向剛度假設下可用線性分配追蹤軸力與力矩，但土層差異、斜樁及承台柔性會改變分擔。各樁反力需要同時滿足總力及總矩，並檢查是否有拉拔；群樁效率和地盤整體破壞不能由單樁算式直接保證。 假設4支等剛度樁、兩支x=+3m兩支−3m，P=12000kN、M=12000kN·m，Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx²，得4000與2000kN。 ~A rigid cap over equal axial stiffnesses permits linear sharing of force and moment. Different soils, battered piles and cap flexibility alter that distribution. Reactions must satisfy both total force and moment and be checked for uplift. Neither group efficiency nor overall ground failure is established by a single-pile resistance equation or a convenient equal-load assumption alone. Assume four equal-stiffness piles, two each at x=±3m,P=12000kN,M=12000kN·m. Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx² gives4000 and2000kN.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設4支等剛度樁、兩支x=+3m兩支−3m，P=12000kN、M=12000kN·m，Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx²，得4000與2000kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four equal-stiffness piles, two each at x=±3m,P=12000kN,M=12000kN·m. Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx² gives4000 and2000kN.
units.verify: 畫樁位坐標並核對力矩軸，逐樁求反力後重新加總力及力矩。用地層和試驗證據檢查等剛度，另列承台柔性與樁群影響，不能只因平衡成立就接受全部反力分配。~Plot pile coordinates and moment axis, then independently sum calculated reactions and moments. Test equal stiffness against geology and pile evidence, reviewing cap flexibility and group effects separately because satisfying equilibrium does not prove that the assumed distribution is physically realistic.
units.failure: 某支樁剛度下降會把荷載移轉給其他樁，算術平均仍可能掩蓋局部超載。樁位偏移或力矩軸弄錯時，總力雖正確但反力高低側可能完全相反。~A softened pile transfers load to neighbors while a simple average hides concentration. Position errors or an incorrect moment axis can also preserve total force yet assign the largest reactions to the wrong side of the group.
units.misconception: 只要樁數相同每支樁在任何偏心荷載下都承擔相同軸力。~Equal pile count means every pile carries identical axial force under any eccentric loading.
units.practice: 畫樁位坐標並核對力矩軸，逐樁求反力後重新加總力及力矩。用地層和試驗證據檢查等剛度，另列承台柔性與樁群影響，不能只因平衡成立就接受全部反力分配。~Plot pile coordinates and moment axis, then independently sum calculated reactions and moments. Test equal stiffness against geology and pile evidence, reviewing cap flexibility and group effects separately because satisfying equilibrium does not prove that the assumed distribution is physically realistic.

units.anchor: 樁身彈性縮短~Elastic pile shortening
units.title: 樁身彈性縮短~Elastic pile shortening
units.mechanism: 長樁在受壓時材料本身會縮短，樁頂沉陷因此不全來自地基。均勻軸力模型只適用一段不沿程卸載的杆件，實際樁因側阻傳力而軸力隨深度改變，應分段積分；混凝土齡期、徐變與鋼材截面損失也可能影響有效軸向剛度。 假設均勻P=2MN、L=30m、E=200GPa、A=0.060m²，δ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm；未含土體沉陷。 ~A long pile shortens under compression, so head settlement is not entirely ground movement. A uniform-force rod represents a segment without load shedding; real shaft transfer changes force with depth and requires segmented integration. Concrete age, creep and steel-section loss additionally alter effective axial stiffness, and these contributions must be separated when interpreting observed pile-head displacement. Assume uniform P=2MN,L=30m,E=200GPa,A=0.060m². Elastic shorteningδ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm, excluding ground settlement.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻P=2MN、L=30m、E=200GPa、A=0.060m²，δ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm；未含土體沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform P=2MN,L=30m,E=200GPa,A=0.060m². Elastic shorteningδ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm, excluding ground settlement.
units.verify: 從傳力量測建立沿深度軸力分布，用分段EA計算材料縮短，核對儀器標距和溫度。再把樁頂與樁端位移比較，分開材料壓縮和地盤反應，避免用單一頂部位移反推全部端阻。~Build the depthwise force profile from load-transfer evidence and integrate shortening with segmented EA, checking gauge length and temperature. Compare head and toe movements to separate material compression from ground response rather than inferring all toe behavior from one head displacement.
units.failure: 將樁頂全部位移當成土體沉陷會低估地基剛度，反之忽略土體位移則高估樁身壓縮。側阻傳遞很強時，以頂部最大軸力套全長會過度預測縮短。~Assigning all head movement to soil understates ground stiffness, while omitting ground movement overstates material compression. With strong shaft transfer, applying the maximum head force along the entire length exaggerates elastic shortening of the pile.
units.misconception: 樁頂沉陷完全來自土壤所以樁身彈性縮短永遠可以忽略。~Pile-head settlement comes entirely from soil, so elastic pile shortening can always be ignored.
units.practice: 從傳力量測建立沿深度軸力分布，用分段EA計算材料縮短，核對儀器標距和溫度。再把樁頂與樁端位移比較，分開材料壓縮和地盤反應，避免用單一頂部位移反推全部端阻。~Build the depthwise force profile from load-transfer evidence and integrate shortening with segmented EA, checking gauge length and temperature. Compare head and toe movements to separate material compression from ground response rather than inferring all toe behavior from one head displacement.

units.anchor: 側向彎曲基準~Lateral bending baseline
units.title: 側向彎曲基準~Lateral bending baseline
units.mechanism: 海上樁承受水平荷載時，露出段與土中支承共同控制變形。理想懸臂固定端只提供一個結構基準，不代表真實泥面就是完全固接，土體非線性和群樁遮蔽需要另建模型；自由長度選錯會因三次方關係放大樁頭側向撓度的預測誤差。 假設理想懸臂P=100kN、L=10m、E=200GPa、I=0.0074m⁴，δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm，根部矩1000kN·m。 ~Lateral pile response combines the exposed segment with support from embedded soil. An ideal fixed cantilever supplies a structural baseline, not proof that the mudline is perfectly clamped. Nonlinear soil and group shadowing need additional modeling. An incorrectly selected free length magnifies deflection through its cubic dependence, even when material stiffness and load are otherwise correctly specified. Assume ideal cantilever P=100kN,L=10m,E=200GPa,I=0.0074m⁴. δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm and root moment1000kN·m, excluding soil flexibility.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設理想懸臂P=100kN、L=10m、E=200GPa、I=0.0074m⁴，δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm，根部矩1000kN·m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume ideal cantilever P=100kN,L=10m,E=200GPa,I=0.0074m⁴. δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm and root moment1000kN·m, excluding soil flexibility.
units.verify: 標出固定端是假設位置並核對露出長度，用位移及應變量測檢查彎曲形狀。比較含土彈簧與懸臂基準的差異，另檢查循環荷載和群樁效應，不將示意固定端當成現地邊界。~Mark the assumed fixed point and exposed length and check bending shape against displacement and strain observations. Compare soil-supported and cantilever responses, reviewing cyclic and group effects separately rather than treating the illustrative clamp as an established site boundary.
units.failure: 把泥面誤當完全固定可能低估水平位移，沖刷加深後若仍用舊長度則再次低估需求。樁頭接合轉動也會改變彎矩分布，不能只核對一個頂端位移。~Treating the mudline as perfectly fixed can understate lateral movement, and retaining old length after scour adds further error. Pile-head connection rotation also changes moment distribution, so checking one head displacement is insufficient.
units.misconception: 海床泥面在所有情況下都可直接視為樁身完全固定端。~The seabed mudline can always be treated as a perfectly fixed pile support.
units.practice: 標出固定端是假設位置並核對露出長度，用位移及應變量測檢查彎曲形狀。比較含土彈簧與懸臂基準的差異，另檢查循環荷載和群樁效應，不將示意固定端當成現地邊界。~Mark the assumed fixed point and exposed length and check bending shape against displacement and strain observations. Compare soil-supported and cantilever responses, reviewing cyclic and group effects separately rather than treating the illustrative clamp as an established site boundary.

units.anchor: 沖刷與側向剛度~Scour and lateral stiffness
units.title: 沖刷與側向剛度~Scour and lateral stiffness
units.mechanism: 沖刷移除上部土支承，可能增加有效自由長度並改變樁的水平剛度，作用不只是少了一層保護石。以固定彎曲剛度懸臂比較可看三次方敏感度，但真實固定點會隨土體反應移動，海床回填也不必然立即恢復原支承，需持續觀測。 假設同EI懸臂有效長度由10增至12m，k=3EI/L³，剛度比(10/12)³=0.5787，減少42.13%；非完整樁土預測。 ~Scour removes near-surface support and can increase effective free length, changing lateral stiffness rather than merely removing armor. A constant-EI cantilever illustrates cubic sensitivity, but the effective fixity also shifts with soil response. Sediment refill does not necessarily restore original support immediately, requiring continued observation instead of assuming that a visually recovered bed reinstates the previous behavior. Assume fixed-EI cantilever length increases10to12m. k=3EI/L³ gives stiffness ratio0.5787, a42.13% reduction, not a complete pile-soil prediction.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同EI懸臂有效長度由10增至12m，k=3EI/L³，剛度比(10/12)³=0.5787，減少42.13%；非完整樁土預測。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed-EI cantilever length increases10to12m. k=3EI/L³ gives stiffness ratio0.5787, a42.13% reduction, not a complete pile-soil prediction.
units.verify: 比較樁周沖刷坑和遠處海床基準，記錄不同潮波後的三維地形。用側向量測檢查支承變化，將回淤材料密度與原土區分，避免只因床面高程回復就宣告剛度恢復。~Map local scour relative to the surrounding bed after different tide-wave events. Check support changes through lateral observations and distinguish refill density from original soil, avoiding a declaration of restored stiffness solely because the bed elevation has returned.
units.failure: 冲刷坑局部最深處可能被稀疏測線漏掉，平均海床高程不變仍可有單樁失去支承。鬆散回淤又可能在下次波流迅速移除，留下反覆剛度變化。~Sparse surveys may miss the deepest local hole, so unchanged average bed level can conceal support loss at one pile. Loose refill may be removed quickly during the next event, repeatedly altering lateral stiffness.
units.misconception: 沖刷只影響外觀而不會改變樁基水平剛度和彎矩需求。~Scour affects appearance only and cannot change lateral pile stiffness or bending demand.
units.practice: 比較樁周沖刷坑和遠處海床基準，記錄不同潮波後的三維地形。用側向量測檢查支承變化，將回淤材料密度與原土區分，避免只因床面高程回復就宣告剛度恢復。~Map local scour relative to the surrounding bed after different tide-wave events. Check support changes through lateral observations and distinguish refill density from original soil, avoiding a declaration of restored stiffness solely because the bed elevation has returned.

units.anchor: 波流拖曳分量~Wave-current drag component
units.title: 波流拖曳分量~Wave-current drag component
units.mechanism: 細長樁的水動力可分速度拖曳和加速度慣性，兩者在波浪中未必同時達峰。穩定流拖曳基準需要投影直徑與流速，海生物附著會改變粗糙與尺度；不能拿單一拖曳值代表完整波浪荷載，也不能忽略成群樁的遮蔽與局部加速。 假設海水1025kg/m³、Cd=1.2、D=1m、穩定流2m/s，每米拖曳f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m；不含慣性力。 ~Hydrodynamic action on a slender pile includes velocity-dependent drag and acceleration-dependent inertia, whose peaks need not coincide. A steady-flow drag baseline requires projected diameter and speed, with marine growth altering roughness and dimensions. One drag value cannot represent complete wave loading, and pile-group shielding or local acceleration may modify the action around individual members. Assume seawater1025kg/m³,Cd=1.2,D=1m and steady speed2m/s. Drag per length f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m, excluding inertia.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設海水1025kg/m³、Cd=1.2、D=1m、穩定流2m/s，每米拖曳f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m；不含慣性力。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume seawater1025kg/m³,Cd=1.2,D=1m and steady speed2m/s. Drag per length f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m, excluding inertia.
units.verify: 核對流速方向和量測高度，記錄海生物附著、樁群間距與所用拖曳係數的範圍。波浪情境另保存速度與加速度時序，分相位計算兩分量，不任意把不同時刻峰值直接相加。~Check velocity direction and elevation, recording marine growth, group spacing and the drag coefficient's evidence range. For waves, retain velocity and acceleration histories and calculate phase-resolved components rather than summing peaks occurring at unrelated times in the cycle.
units.failure: 使用未附著的直徑可能低估長期拖曳，忽略慣性則漏掉短週期作用。將遮蔽係數套用所有流向也可能低估前排或局部通道中的高流速需求。~Using a clean diameter can understate long-term drag, while omitted inertia misses short-period action. Applying one shielding factor to every direction may also understate loads on leading piles or in accelerated local flow passages.
units.misconception: 穩定流拖曳算式已經自動包含波浪造成的全部慣性作用。~The steady-current drag formula automatically includes all wave-induced inertia effects.
units.practice: 核對流速方向和量測高度，記錄海生物附著、樁群間距與所用拖曳係數的範圍。波浪情境另保存速度與加速度時序，分相位計算兩分量，不任意把不同時刻峰值直接相加。~Check velocity direction and elevation, recording marine growth, group spacing and the drag coefficient's evidence range. For waves, retain velocity and acceleration histories and calculate phase-resolved components rather than summing peaks occurring at unrelated times in the cycle.

units.anchor: 腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面~Corrosion loss and remaining section
units.title: 腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面~Corrosion loss and remaining section
units.mechanism: 海水區鋼樁腐蝕常隨高程和環境變化，平均減薄無法代表局部凹蝕或焊縫。假設外徑不變且內壁損失只是一種幾何情境，真實腐蝕可能雙面發生；剩餘面積比例也不是剩餘壽命或承載比例，還需檢查彎曲、局部穩定及疲勞。 假設外徑固定1m，壁厚由20降至17mm，內徑0.960變0.966m，剩餘面積比[1−0.966²]/[1−0.960²]=0.8526。 ~Marine corrosion varies with elevation and environment, and average loss does not describe pitting or weld zones. Fixed outer diameter with internal loss is only one geometry; actual attack may occur on both faces. Remaining area fraction is neither remaining life nor overall capacity, since bending, local stability and fatigue depend on additional features of the damaged member. Assume fixed outer diameter1m and wall thickness20to17mm, so inner diameter0.960to0.966m. Remaining annular-area ratio is0.8526, not remaining life.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑固定1m，壁厚由20降至17mm，內徑0.960變0.966m，剩餘面積比[1−0.966²]/[1−0.960²]=0.8526。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed outer diameter1m and wall thickness20to17mm, so inner diameter0.960to0.966m. Remaining annular-area ratio is0.8526, not remaining life.
units.verify: 按高程和周向建立厚度地圖，保留最薄區與量測不確定度，說明損失是在內外哪一面。將更新截面帶回軸力彎矩與穩定分析，另檢查塗層和陰極防蝕狀態而非只報平均減薄。~Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face. Recompute axial, bending and stability demands using updated geometry, reviewing coating and cathodic-protection condition separately rather than reporting only mean thickness loss.
units.failure: 水線附近局部深蝕可在平均截面尚大時控制失效，內外面誤判又會改變慣性矩。用平均腐蝕速率外推壽命，可能漏掉環境變化和保護系統失效後的加速。~Deep localized attack near the waterline can govern despite a large average remaining area, and misidentified corrosion faces alter inertia. Extrapolating mean corrosion rate misses environmental changes or acceleration following loss of protective-system performance.
units.misconception: 剩餘截面百分比必定等於鋼樁剩餘使用年限的百分比。~The remaining cross-sectional percentage necessarily equals the percentage of service life remaining.
units.practice: 按高程和周向建立厚度地圖，保留最薄區與量測不確定度，說明損失是在內外哪一面。將更新截面帶回軸力彎矩與穩定分析，另檢查塗層和陰極防蝕狀態而非只報平均減薄。~Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face. Recompute axial, bending and stability demands using updated geometry, reviewing coating and cathodic-protection condition separately rather than reporting only mean thickness loss.

units.anchor: 循環需求與疲勞~Cyclic demand and fatigue
units.title: 循環需求與疲勞~Cyclic demand and fatigue
units.mechanism: 波流與靠泊反覆作用在焊縫及接頭形成疲勞需求，應力範圍和循環次數需共同描述。線性損傷累積假設忽略載入順序、腐蝕交互及裂縫成長細節，只適合有相應曲線的初步比較；損傷比未到某值也不能取代檢查或保證剩餘壽命。 假設兩級循環n1=100000、N1=1000000，n2=200000、N2=500000，Miner D=Σn/N=0.50；非剩餘壽命保證。 ~Repeated waves and berthing create fatigue demand at welds and connections, requiring stress ranges together with cycle counts. Linear cumulative damage ignores sequence, corrosion interaction and detailed crack growth, supporting only a preliminary comparison with appropriate fatigue curves. A calculated fraction does not replace inspection or guarantee remaining life, especially when local details differ from those represented by the selected curve. Assume cycle pairs n1=100000,N1=1000000 and n2=200000,N2=500000. Miner D=Σn/N=0.50, not a remaining-life guarantee.
units.model: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩級循環n1=100000、N1=1000000，n2=200000、N2=500000，Miner D=Σn/N=0.50；非剩餘壽命保證。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cycle pairs n1=100000,N1=1000000 and n2=200000,N2=500000. Miner D=Σn/N=0.50, not a remaining-life guarantee.
units.verify: 追蹤應力範圍來源與循環計數方法，核對疲勞曲線是否適合實際焊縫和環境。將裂縫檢查、腐蝕減薄與載入歷史一起比對，記錄缺測區段及可能漏算的高幅事件。~Trace stress-range derivation and cycle counting, verifying curve applicability to the actual weld and environment. Compare crack inspections, corrosion loss and load history together, documenting missing periods and high-amplitude events that may not be represented in the recorded data.
units.failure: 名義應力沒有反映焊趾集中時會低估疲勞，少數大波事件也可能主導損傷。累積比看似不高但既有裂縫已發展時，仍需獨立評估而不能依比例延後處理。~Nominal stress can miss weld-toe concentration, and a few large-wave events may dominate damage. A modest cumulative fraction does not justify deferring assessment when an existing crack has already developed in the actual connection.
units.misconception: Miner損傷比等於一半就保證還能再使用同樣長的時間。~A Miner damage fraction of one half guarantees an equally long remaining service period.
units.practice: 追蹤應力範圍來源與循環計數方法，核對疲勞曲線是否適合實際焊縫和環境。將裂縫檢查、腐蝕減薄與載入歷史一起比對，記錄缺測區段及可能漏算的高幅事件。~Trace stress-range derivation and cycle counting, verifying curve applicability to the actual weld and environment. Compare crack inspections, corrosion loss and load history together, documenting missing periods and high-amplitude events that may not be represented in the recorded data.

title: 棧橋式碼頭樁基~Pile-supported pier foundations
summary: 由海床調查到樁群變形與耐久追蹤棧橋碼頭荷載。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。~Trace pile-supported pier loads from seabed investigation to group deformation and durability. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
history: 棧橋碼頭把平台荷載經樁傳入海床，與重力沉箱的連續底面接觸有不同分析需求。一九九一年工兵團樁基手冊涵蓋調查、試樁與設計；香港碼頭與繫船墩分冊另提供海事使用背景，實際應用仍須核對現行修訂。洛杉磯港官方紀錄一七七至一八二號碼頭重建在二〇二三年開始、二〇二五年完成，工程議程包含混凝土樁與新碼頭。本課鋼管幾何只是另一材料情境，不把它說成該專案規格。北角碼頭則比較公共通達功能。十個算例以原創數據串起截面、土阻、變形、沖刷及耐久。~A pile-supported pier transfers deck loads into the seabed through discrete members, unlike continuous base contact beneath a gravity caisson. The1991 USACE manual addresses exploration, testing and pile design, while Hong Kong pier-and-dolphin guidance adds maritime context subject to current revisions. Los Angeles records Berths177–182 restoration beginning in2023 and completing in2025, with official agenda material identifying concrete piles and a new wharf. Steel-pipe geometry here is a separate material scenario, not that project’s specification. Pak Kok provides a public-access comparison. Ten original numerical exercises connect sections, soil resistance, deformation, scour and durability.
example: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。假設外徑1m增10%至1.1m、壁厚固定20mm且軸力固定，面積由0.061575增至0.067858m²，平均應力由32.48降至29.47MPa；未代表地工承載同步增加。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。~This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling. Increasing outer diameter10% from1to1.1m at fixed20mm thickness and load raises area from0.061575 to0.067858m² and lowers mean stress from32.48 to29.47MPa, without an equivalent geotechnical capacity claim. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a closed circular toe1m in diameter with uniform qb=5MPa. Qb=3927.0kN; this footprint is not assumed for an unverified open-pile plug.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設D=1m、有效段長20m、均勻正側阻τ=50kPa，Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN；不含負摩擦或端阻。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume diameter1m,effective length20m and uniform positive shaft shear50kPa. Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN, excluding downdrag and toe resistance.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設4支等剛度樁、兩支x=+3m兩支−3m，P=12000kN、M=12000kN·m，Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx²，得4000與2000kN。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four equal-stiffness piles, two each at x=±3m,P=12000kN,M=12000kN·m. Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx² gives4000 and2000kN.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻P=2MN、L=30m、E=200GPa、A=0.060m²，δ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm；未含土體沉陷。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform P=2MN,L=30m,E=200GPa,A=0.060m². Elastic shorteningδ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm, excluding ground settlement.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設理想懸臂P=100kN、L=10m、E=200GPa、I=0.0074m⁴，δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm，根部矩1000kN·m。~Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume ideal cantilever P=100kN,L=10m,E=200GPa,I=0.0074m⁴. δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm and root moment1000kN·m, excluding soil flexibility.
